newsitem.title: USA: Xenometrix may face activity curtailment.
newsitem.headline: Xenometrix may face activity curtailment.

text.p: Xenometrix Inc said Tuesday its operating activities will be "significantly curtailed" if it is unable to obtain needed financing.

The company said it is pursuing a short-term bridge financing consisting of a private placement coupled with common stock warrants. It also said it has retained an investment banking firm to help it raise additional equity capital.
"In the event that such financing cannot be consummated, the company's operating activities will be significantly curtailed," the biotechnology firm said in a statement.
The company said its available cash resources should be sufficient to sustain its current level of operations through June.
Xenometrix shares closed up 1/16 Tuesday at 5-15/16.
